# UX Navigation Requirements Checklist: Workspace Navigation Fix

**Purpose**: Validate whether the Workspace navigation requirements are complete, clear, consistent, measurable, and ready for implementation planning.
**Created**: 2026-05-16
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are all enabled Workspace sidebar targets required to map to exactly one active displayed detail/domain area? [Completeness, Spec §FR-002, Contract §Enabled Navigation Targets]
- [ ] CHK002 Are overview CTA targets covered by the same navigation requirements as sidebar targets? [Completeness, Plan §Summary, Contract §Scope]
- [ ] CHK003 Are requirements defined for missing, valid, and invalid hash entry states? [Completeness, Spec §FR-006-FR-008, Contract §Hash Entry Contract]
- [ ] CHK004 Are disabled or future navigation items explicitly separated from enabled targets? [Completeness, Contract §Disabled Navigation Targets]
- [ ] CHK005 Are requirements defined for preserving existing Workspace artifact flows after navigation changes? [Completeness, Spec §FR-015]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK006 Is the active displayed detail/domain requirement clear enough to prevent URL-only or focus-only behavior from satisfying navigation? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, Plan §Note]
- [ ] CHK007 Is the fallback destination for missing or invalid hash states defined with enough specificity? [Clarity, Spec §FR-007-FR-008, Data Model §Active Workspace Navigation State]
- [ ] CHK008 Are "active sidebar item", "active section", and "focused section" used consistently as distinct concepts? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001-FR-005]
- [ ] CHK009 Are the canonical target fields sufficiently defined to guide implementation without adding persisted data? [Clarity, Data Model §Workspace Navigation Target]
- [ ] CHK010 Is the disabled state for "Assistencia de design de testes" specified clearly enough to avoid accidental AI scope expansion? [Clarity, Contract §Expected Target Coverage]

## Requirement Consistency

- [ ] CHK011 Do the spec, plan, data model, and UI contract agree that this is frontend-only navigation behavior? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Constraints, Data Model §Non-entities]
- [ ] CHK012 Do hash synchronization requirements align between the spec and UI contract? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004-FR-006, Contract §Hash Entry Contract]
- [ ] CHK013 Do active-state requirements align between sidebar, domain tabs, and displayed or focused content? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, Contract §Enabled Navigation Targets]
- [ ] CHK014 Are PT-BR language requirements consistent across scope, constraints, and navigation labels? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010/FR-020, Plan §Product language]
- [ ] CHK015 Are out-of-scope boundaries consistent across spec, plan, and quickstart? [Consistency, Spec §FR-012, Plan §Constraints, Quickstart §Preconditions]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [ ] CHK016 Are success criteria measurable without relying on implementation-specific internals? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001-SC-006]
- [ ] CHK017 Is the 100% sidebar target coverage criterion scoped to enabled targets to avoid conflict with disabled, future, or out-of-scope items? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001, Contract §Disabled Navigation Targets]
- [ ] CHK018 Is direct-entry and reload behavior measurable for every valid hash target? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-002]
- [ ] CHK019 Is active-state consistency measurable across hash, sidebar, and active content state? [Acceptance Criteria, Spec §SC-003]
- [ ] CHK020 Is "no broad visual redesign" defined well enough for reviewer judgment? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005, Plan §Constraints]

## Scenario Coverage

- [ ] CHK021 Are primary sidebar activation scenarios covered independently from reload/direct-entry scenarios? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1, Spec §User Story 3]
- [ ] CHK022 Are rapid alternation scenarios represented as requirements or edge cases? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 2, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK023 Are repeated selection scenarios covered so state duplication or inconsistent focus is ruled out? [Coverage, Spec §User Story 1]
- [ ] CHK024 Are overview-card or quick-action navigation sources covered, not only sidebar sources? [Coverage, Plan §Summary, Contract §Scope]
- [ ] CHK025 Are disabled target scenarios covered without requiring new placeholder product surfaces? [Coverage, Contract §Disabled Navigation Targets]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [ ] CHK027 Are long-section focus requirements clear enough to avoid content being hidden or overlapped? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [ ] CHK028 Are local/mock data and hydration-sensitive states considered in reload requirements? [Edge Cases, Spec §Edge Cases, Plan §Performance Goals]

- [ ] CHK030 Are fallback requirements explicit enough to prevent misleading active sidebar state? [Edge Cases, Spec §FR-008, Contract §Hash Entry Contract]
